title: vault-config.yaml — /review setup for one period kind
description: Canonical input contract for `scripts/vault-config-writer.py review` (spec 045, ADR-5). One confirmed setup for one period kind. The writer edits only the config keys the input names — concepts.calendar.granularities.<weekly|monthly>, naming.calendar_patterns.<weekly|monthly>, templates.mapping.<weekly|monthly> and the review: section — and leaves every other byte of vault-config.yaml unchanged. An optional key that is absent changes nothing; a null template or template_variant removes the config key. The week rule is required for kind week and not accepted for kind month. The daily folder path is corrected only when daily_path_fix is present.

trimmed.description: A non-empty string with no whitespace at either end.

kind.description: The period kind this setup is for; selects the weekly or monthly keys.

folder.description: Vault folder of the periodic notes (concepts.calendar.granularities.<kind>.path); enabled is set to true.

format.description: Moment-style name format (naming.calendar_patterns.<kind>), e.g. GGGG-[W]WW or YYYY-MM; checked by period.check_format under the input's week rule.

first_day.description: First day of the week (review.week.first_day); kind week only.

min_days.description: Days of the new year week 1 must hold (review.week.min_days_in_first_week); 4 = ISO, 1 = week 1 contains 1 January; kind week only.

template.description: Template filename under templates.base_path (templates.mapping.<kind>); null removes the mapping key; absent leaves it as it is.

template_variant.description: Tomo-ready variant of a Templater template (review.<kind>.template_variant); null removes the key.

heading.description: Text of the review heading without # marks (review.<kind>.heading).

anchor.description: Text of the heading the review section is placed at (review.<kind>.place.anchor).

placement.description: before = at the anchor's level above it; inside = one level deeper at the end of its section. after is never accepted (ADR-3).

own_sections.description: Headings of the periodic note the user writes by hand (review.<kind>.own_sections).

skip_sections.description: Daily-note sections never read, prefix match on the heading text (review.daily.skip_sections).

task_notes.description: Vault paths of living task notes (review.daily.task_notes).

language.description: Review language as a BCP 47 primary tag with an optional subtag (review.language), e.g. de, en, pt-BR.

daily_path_fix.description: Corrected daily folder path (concepts.calendar.granularities.daily.path); present only when the user confirmed the correction.
